turns.question: How much of our campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: About 4,130 EUR of campaign budget was left at the end of September 2026, the month-end remaining budget summed over campaigns for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Freshness: Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
